ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark/black) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) punctate disruptions across approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is uniformly dark charcoal. High-contrast white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips. A mapping of white punctate speckles is distributed across the central-to-lower ventral surface of both lobes, with a more pronounced, roughly horizontal linear white cluster on the medial-distal region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 105 degrees, showing a clean, sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is characterized by low-amplitude, smooth undulations. The right lobe trailing edge displays higher-frequency serrations with irregular peaks and valleys, particularly in the distal third near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep on the leading edges; trailing edges follow a generally linear trajectory with a slight terminal concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, high-contrast clusters of yellowish-brown and white pixel masses are located at both the left and right distal tips. Punctate white pixel clusters (scars) are scattered globally across the dark surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, horizontal-to-diagonal white linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular protuberant masses (yellowish-brown and white) attached to the distal tips of both lobes, appearing as significant topographical additions to the natural fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity white pixel noise present around the central fluke region and trailing edges due to water turbulence and airborne droplets.
